# DATABASE: LayersTesting

| Field       | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| Version     | 20261020 V1 |
| Description | Persistence contract for the cash ledger: three tables, their access patterns, and integer-cent amounts. |
| Depends On  | ARCHITECTURE.md |
| Provides    | persistence.open_database, accounts, categories, transactions tables |

## Access Patterns

Access patterns are owned by the feature that reaches them. Each operation below names exactly one table and one verb.

| Pattern | Owner | Access | Named operation | Compatibility |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-001` | FEATURE-Acct-Add.md | read-write | `accounts.create` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-002` | FEATURE-Acct-Get.md | read | `accounts.get` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-003` | FEATURE-Report-Balances.md | read | `accounts.list` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-004` | FEATURE-Acct-Rename.md | read-write | `accounts.update` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-005` | FEATURE-Acct-Delete.md | read-write | `accounts.delete` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-006` | FEATURE-Load-Categories.md | read-write | `categories.create` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-007` | FEATURE-Report-Categories.md | read | `categories.get` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-008` | FEATURE-Report-Categories.md | read | `categories.list` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-009` | FEATURE-Txn-Post.md | read-write | `transactions.create` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-010` | FEATURE-Txn-Get.md | read | `transactions.get` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-011` | FEATURE-Report-Monthly.md | read | `transactions.list` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-012` | FEATURE-Txn-Amend.md | read-write | `transactions.update` | unchanged |
| `FEATURE-LEDGER-013` | FEATURE-Txn-Delete.md | read-write | `transactions.delete` | unchanged |

## Schema

## `accounts`

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `account` | VARCHAR(12) PK NOT NULL | Account code, `A-Z` and `0-9`. |
| `name` | VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL | Account name; no comma or newline. |

## `categories`

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `category` | VARCHAR(12) PK NOT NULL | Category code, `A-Z` and `0-9`. |
| `description` | VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL | Category description; no comma or newline. |

## `transactions`

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `txn_id` | INTEGER PK NOT NULL | Transaction id. |
| `date` | TEXT NOT NULL | Calendar date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `account` | VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account) | Owning account. |
| `category` | VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(category) | Category. |
| `amount` | INTEGER NOT NULL | Amount in integer cents. |
| `memo` | VARCHAR(60) | Memo; 0 to 60 characters, no comma or newline. |

## Programmatic Acceptance

```python
from persistence import open_database

db = open_database()
assert callable(db.accounts.create) and callable(db.transactions.delete)
assert all(isinstance(t.amount, int) for t in db.transactions.list())
```

## User Acceptance

- None.

## Guardrails

- Amounts are stored as integer cents and never as floating point.
- Application code reaches the store only through the generated persistence package.
- Within a release the schema is built once and never migrated.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
